title: 16.52. Sanidassanattika, Sappaccayaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Anidassanaappaṭigho appaccayo dhammo nasanidassanasappaṭighassa naappaccayassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
Ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
